headline: Biden order directs agencies to rebuild the U.S. refugee resettlement program and study how climate change affects migration.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order tells federal agencies to rebuild and expand the programs that bring refugees to the United States and help them settle. It also calls for planning around how climate change may cause people to move or be displaced. No summary was provided, so specific details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Refugees seeking to resettle in the United States
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to rebuild and expand the programs that process and resettle refugees.

who_it_affects.group: Refugee resettlement agencies and the communities that host refugees
who_it_affects.how: These groups help carry out resettlement programs that the order seeks to strengthen.
The order calls for federal planning on how climate change affects migration.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 4, 2021; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
